entries.title: cmHC: Balancing Stream Mixing in Hyper-Connections via Geometric Contraction
entries.summary: Manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) extends residual connections to multiple streams and stabilizes residual propagation by constraining stream-mixing residual matrices to the Birkhoff polytope, the set of doubly stochastic matrices.
